verdicts.why: 'the month' is not contiguous in seed target 'last month' (the seed renders 'el mes pasado' as 'last month'), but the row glosses words of its own LEGO.
'I don't' glosses 'no' of its own LEGO 'no puedo recordar'; the seed has 'I can't remember', where the negation is fused into 'can't'.
'not' glosses 'no' in LEGO 'no deberías'; the seed fuses it as "shouldn't".
'that' glosses 'que' of its own LEGO 'que funcione'; the seed 'it will work' does not render the particle.
'at night' glosses 'por la noche' of its own LEGO; the seed has 'on Saturday night', so 'at night' is not present as text.
'there is' glosses 'hay' in LEGO 'no hay problema'; the seed 'no problem' does not render it.
'the year' glosses 'el año' in own LEGO 'el año que viene'; the seed renders it as 'next year'.
'the friend' glosses 'la amiga'; the seed has the reordered possessive "my sister's friend" with 'friend' separated from the article.
'in the afternoon' glosses 'por la tarde' of its own LEGO; the seed condenses it to 'tomorrow afternoon'.
'at night' glosses 'por la noche' of its own LEGO; the seed says 'on Saturday night'.
'with' glosses 'con' of own LEGO 'con cuidado'; the seed renders it as 'carefully'.
'in the morning' glosses 'por la mañana' of its own LEGO; the seed says 'on Sunday morning'.
'about other' glosses 'de otra'; the seed has 'about something else', with 'other' not present as a word.
'myself' glosses the clitic 'me' in 'cansarme'; the seed has 'feel tired' with no 'myself'.
'you have to' glosses 'tienes que' of own LEGO; the seed says 'you need to do', so 'have to' is not present.
Row and LEGO say 'she'; the seed says "he didn't want to look after", so the seed disagrees with its LEGOs; the pronoun conflict needs escalation.
'that' glosses 'que' in LEGO 'me temo que'; the seed "I'm afraid I haven't" has no 'that'.
'more' glosses 'más' of own LEGO 'más tiempo'; the seed renders the phrase as 'longer'.
'much' glosses 'de mucha' of own LEGO 'de mucha ayuda'; the seed says 'very helpful'.
'that' glosses 'que' in LEGO 'que haga'; the seed 'want me to do' does not render the particle.
